verdict.rationale: Blink's GitHub README lists scp and sftp (plus curl with scp/sftp support) as bundled commands and shows usage examples for both. The docs describe SSH key creation and management and host configuration, so transfers to and from remote hosts are clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that scp/sftp use the keys and hosts configured in Blink, in-depth transfer docs (options, directories, progress), and independent hands-on corroboration of file transfers.
